'''Minst''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a member of the [[War Trust]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
During the early stages of the [[Galactic War]], Minst was stationed at the dismantled reactor core in the sewer section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. There he oversaw processing of the materials for [[Project Siantide]]&mdash;the residue of life-forms incarcerated during the [[Destruction of Taris]]&mdash;were exposed to radiation from the station, creating an extremely powerful energy source. When [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] [[Destruction of the War Trust|stormed]] the facility and killed many of Minst's troops, the General left a [[Minst (decoy)|decoy grunt]] to pose as him and set the reactor to self-destruct, while taking shelter in a secure room. However, his decoy cracked after his comrades were slaughtered, before he was promptly executed by the [[Sith Warrior]]. The Warrior then managed to get inside Minst's shelter before the reactor detonated. Having barely escaped being incinerated, Minst gloated that at least the Sith was unable to duplicate Project: Siantide. However, the Sith was not interested in Siantide and killed both Minst and his aide.
{{Endgame}}
